title: MCR C04 social v0.1.0 review candidate

IntroAudience.description: Author-only audience bounds. Both age bounds are present or both are null; the upper bound is half-open. This object is never part of a viewer-facing projection.

then.description: minimum_age < maximum_age_exclusive; the server enforces the pairing in the same transaction.

IntroPostDetail.description: Viewer-facing intro post. Deliberately carries no audience, age bound, gender bound, room reference, or external-account field.

OwnIntroPost.description: Author-only projection. audience_summary is server-derived so the client never recomputes bounds.

IntroLikeState.description: like_count is null only on the DELETE path when the viewer no longer satisfies the audience, so removing your own heart never discloses the current count.

RoomLayout.description: Fixed-grid personal room layout. Carries no intro post and no event reference.
